title: Cognitive Effects of Textual, Graphical, and Interactive Explanations in Explainable Artificial Intelligence
summary: Examines how textual, graphical, and interactive explanation modalities shape cognitive processing, understanding, and user experience in explainable-AI systems.

title: Human-Centered Explainable Artificial Intelligence and the Effects of Explanation Modalities on Trust, Understanding, and Decision Making
summary: Investigates how explanation modalities influence trust, understanding, and decision making, placing human outcomes at the centre of explainable-AI evaluation.

title: MidiPy: A Python Application for Processing MIDI Data in Improvised Active Music Therapy
summary: Presents open-source Python research software for transforming MIDI event streams into reproducible measures and visual analytics for music-therapy research.

title: Seeing Through Risk: A Symbolic Approximation of Prospect Theory
summary: Explores a symbolic approximation of Prospect Theory for interpretable modeling of risk-sensitive decisions.

title: Statistically-Guided Kernel Regression: Embedding Feature Relevance into Kernel Learning
summary: Embeds statistically estimated feature relevance directly into kernel learning for regression.

title: Any-Class Presence Likelihood for Robust Multi-Label Classification with Abundant Negative Data
summary: Improves multi-label classification when datasets contain many examples in which none of the target classes is present.

title: Conditional Denoising Diffusion Model for Missing Value Imputation in Smart Meter Data
summary: Applies conditional denoising diffusion to reconstruct missing smart-meter observations in high-resolution energy data.

title: Linear Lens: A Human-Centered, Non-Interventional Mechanistic Approach to Explainable AI
summary: Introduces a non-interventional framework for tracing predictive information through neural networks and translating internal representations into human-centered evidence.

title: Monotone Delta: An Order-Theoretic Tournament Graph Approach for Internal Consistency Assessment
summary: Develops an order-theoretic tournament-graph method for assessing internal consistency in structured comparative settings.

title: Distributional Feature Separability for Explainability of Neural Networks for Financial Credit Evaluation
summary: Explains credit-model behavior through the distributional separation of features associated with model decisions.

title: Finite-Difference Approximation for Explaining Neural Network Predictions in Financial Credit Evaluation
summary: Uses finite-difference approximations to characterize how input changes affect neural-network credit predictions.

title: Global-Local Image Perceptual Score (GLIPS): Evaluating Photorealistic Quality of AI-Generated Images
summary: Introduces a perceptual score that combines global and local evidence to evaluate the photorealistic quality of AI-generated images.

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Recurrent Network for Short-Term Load Forecasting Across Diverse Consumers
summary: Develops a recurrent architecture based on Kolmogorov-Arnold representations for forecasting heterogeneous consumer loads.

title: Physics-Guided Memory Network for Building Energy Modeling
summary: Combines learned temporal memory with physical guidance to improve the reliability of building-energy modeling.

title: RootSolver: A Cognitive-Inspired Approach to Polynomial Root-Finding with Multiplicity Detection
summary: Presents a cognitive-inspired method for polynomial root finding with explicit multiplicity detection.

title: Towards a Unified Evaluation Framework: Integrating Human Perception and Metrics for AI-Generated Images
summary: Integrates human judgments and automated image-quality metrics into a unified framework for evaluating generated imagery.

title: ChebyRegNet: An Unsupervised Deep Learning Technique for Deformable Medical Image Registration
summary: Develops an unsupervised deep-learning approach for deformable registration of medical images.

title: Graph Attention Convolutional U-Net: A Semantic Segmentation Model for Identifying Flooded Areas
summary: Combines graph attention with a convolutional U-Net to segment flooded regions in imagery.

title: Leveraging Hypernetworks and Learnable Kernels for Consumer Energy Forecasting Across Diverse Consumer Types
summary: Uses hypernetworks and learnable kernels to adapt energy forecasts across diverse consumer profiles.
